# Define the source directory to be compressed
SOURCE_DIR="/path/to/your/folder"

# Define the destination directory where the ZIP file will be saved
DEST_DIR="/path/to/destination/directory"

# Get the current timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS format
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
